actors.name: Mayor of Riverton
actors.private_context: The mayor is aware of the water-main failures and the third burst this morning. They have not yet decided whether to issue a public statement. They consider the political and operational implications of speaking out.

shared_context: Riverton has experienced three water-main bursts, the third occurring this morning (2026-08-12). The mayor is the public official typically expected to address such infrastructure emergencies. There is no prior public statement from the mayor about these failures.
